full_prompt_en: A square decorative night illustration places a small pale-robed figure at the lower left of a garden of towering flowers. The figure stands in profile, looking up into the stems, with a long light cloak and an elongated trailing sash that echoes the vertical growth. Across the center and right, slender blue-green stems rise from a bank of pale stones and dense leaves. Large cup-shaped blossoms open high above the figure in ivory, powder pink, and dusty lavender. Some petals turn outward while others remain softly closed, creating a staggered rhythm of pale shapes against a deep indigo sky. Thin gilded tendrils and branching lines curl across the upper edge. Tiny star-like dots and minute luminous marks shimmer in the dark spaces between stems. The background shifts from near-black navy on the left to soft periwinkle blue toward the right, but the picture remains flat and ornamental rather than atmospheric. Each leaf and petal has a controlled dark contour and fine internal line, with lightly textured color fills. The lower ground is layered into stylized blue shrubs, curling foliage, and rounded cream stones, setting off the figure's light silhouette. The flowers are far larger than the person, giving the garden a dreamlike scale. Soft glow gathers on the pale blossoms and robe; deep blue shadows hold the stems together. The scene feels hushed, intricate, and luminous, like a printed fairy-tale plate with Art Nouveau curves.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性夜景插图，把一位身穿浅色长袍的小人物放在巨型花卉庭园的左下。人物侧身站立，仰望花茎，浅色长披袍与拖长的飘带呼应向上生长的线条。中央与右侧，纤细蓝绿色茎秆从浅色石块和密叶之间升起。大型杯状花在人物头顶高处开放，呈象牙白、粉浅红和灰淡紫。有些花瓣向外翻卷，另一些仍轻轻闭合，在深靛蓝天空前形成参差的浅色节奏。细金色藤线和分枝弯过上方边缘。微小星点与细碎发光笔痕在茎间的暗处闪动。背景从左侧近黑的海军蓝渐转到右侧柔和长春花蓝，但画面仍然平面而装饰性强，没有真实大气纵深。每片叶和花瓣都有受控的深色轮廓及细内部线条，填色带轻微纹理。下方地面分层为程式化蓝色灌丛、卷叶和圆润奶油色石块，衬托人物的浅色剪影。花朵远比人物巨大，赋予庭园梦境般尺度。柔光聚在浅色花瓣和长袍上，深蓝阴影把茎秆联结起来。场景安静、繁密而明亮，如带新艺术曲线的印刷童话画页。
style_prompt_en: A decorative night illustration combines fine dark contours, gently curved Art Nouveau lines, and flat color fields with subtle print grain. Deep navy, indigo, and muted periwinkle form the ground; ivory, powder pink, dusty lavender, and restrained gold create scattered luminous accents. Thin vertical strokes rise through rounded clustered forms, establishing an upward rhythm against broad dark gaps. Small stars and pinpoint highlights punctuate the dense surface. Edges remain carefully drawn, with slight grain softening the colored interiors. Light appears as a quiet glow within pale areas, while dark blue shadow keeps the composition shallow and cohesive. Overlapping layers have tapestry-like depth rather than realistic perspective. The result is intricate, hushed, and dreamlike.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性夜景插图结合细深色轮廓、轻柔弯曲的新艺术线条，以及带细微印刷颗粒的平面色域。深海军蓝、靛蓝与低饱和长春花蓝构成底色；象牙白、粉浅红、灰淡紫和克制金色形成散布的发光重点。纤细竖线穿过圆润聚集的形状，在大片深色空隙前建立向上节奏。小星点和针尖亮部点破密集表面。边缘保持仔细描绘，细颗粒略微软化内部填色。光线在浅色区域形成安静微光，深蓝阴影则让构图保持浅而统一。重叠层次如织毯般有纵深，而非写实透视。成品繁密、静谧而如梦。
theme_en: A solitary pale-robed figure among oversized flowers at night
theme_zh: 夜色中置身巨大花朵之间的浅袍独行者
name: Virginia Frances Sterrett
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
